overview.name: Fleet Health Index
overview.formula: 100 × [0.30 × Availability Index + 0.25 × PR Index + 0.20 × Asset Health Index + 0.15 × Backlog Index + 0.10 × RUL Exposure Index]
overview.scope: Current reporting period; capacity-weighted across included plants.
overview.rules: Each component is normalised to 0–1. Backlog and RUL exposure are reverse-scored so lower risk produces a higher index. Plants with invalid generation/irradiance data are excluded and flagged.
overview.meaning: Higher is better; use the component drill-down before acting on the composite.

overview.name: Portfolio PR
overview.formula: 100 × Σ Actual AC Energy (kWh) ÷ Σ [POA Irradiance (kWh/m²) × Installed DC Capacity (kWp) × Reference Normalisation Factor]
overview.scope: Selected period; energy/capacity aggregation across plants.
overview.rules: Use valid daylight intervals only. Exclude meter resets and invalid irradiance intervals. Apply the same reference conditions used by the site PR model.
overview.meaning: Shows conversion efficiency after normalising for available solar resource.

overview.name: Availability
overview.formula: 100 × Σ Available Capacity-Hours ÷ Σ Scheduled Capacity-Hours
overview.rules: Available capacity excludes forced outage and derated unavailable capacity. Grid outage, curtailment and planned outage are included or excluded according to the selected contractual/technical availability definition.
overview.meaning: Measures capability to operate, not how efficiently sunlight was converted.

overview.name: Revenue at Risk
overview.formula: Σ [Expected Lost Energy (kWh) × Applicable Net Tariff (₹/kWh) × Probability of Loss]
overview.scope: Forward risk horizon shown on the screen, normally 30 days.
overview.rules: Deduct deemed-generation recovery, insurance or other compensation only when configured. Avoid double counting overlapping failure events.
overview.meaning: Estimated commercial exposure, not an invoiced loss.

overview.name: CO₂ Avoided
overview.formula: Eligible Renewable Generation (MWh) × Approved Grid Emission Factor (tCO₂e/MWh)
overview.scope: Selected period or annualised period as labelled.
overview.rules: Use the governed factor for the applicable geography and vintage. Do not count generation already excluded by the reporting boundary.
overview.meaning: Estimated grid emissions displaced by renewable generation.

overview.name: Proactive Share
overview.formula: 100 × (Preventive + Adaptive + Predictive Work Orders) ÷ Total Classified Work Orders
overview.scope: Work orders created or completed in the selected period, according to screen filter.
overview.rules: Exclude cancelled, duplicate and unclassified records. Corrective work is reactive; opportunistic work is classified according to its originating strategy.
overview.meaning: Indicates maintenance-strategy mix; it does not measure work quality.

aivision.name: Inspection Findings
aivision.formula: Count of distinct validated visual findings in the selected inspection population
aivision.scope: Selected plant, inspection type and period.
aivision.rules: Duplicate detections on the same asset/image region are consolidated according to the configured non-maximum suppression and review rules.
aivision.meaning: Volume of detected defects requiring review.

aivision.name: Detection Confidence
aivision.formula: 100 × model probability assigned to the detected defect class
aivision.rules: Confidence is calibrated on the model validation population and reduced when image quality, angle, irradiance or thermal loading fall outside accepted ranges.
aivision.meaning: Strength of visual classification, not severity.

aivision.name: High-Severity Finding Rate
aivision.formula: 100 × findings classified High or Critical severity ÷ validated findings
aivision.rules: Severity follows the governed defect-impact matrix; unreviewed findings remain provisional.
aivision.meaning: Share of findings with material operational or safety consequence.

aivision.name: Estimated Production Loss
aivision.formula: Σ [Affected Capacity (kW) × Expected Performance Reduction × Persistence Duration (h)] ÷ 1000
aivision.scope: Selected findings and forecast/observed persistence window.
aivision.rules: Use asset rating, irradiance/load context and defect persistence; exclude overlapping loss already attributed elsewhere.
aivision.meaning: Estimated energy impact of visual defects.

aivision.name: False Positive Rate
aivision.formula: 100 × reviewed findings rejected as non-defects ÷ reviewed findings
aivision.rules: Do not include unresolved findings; report by defect class and inspection method where possible.
aivision.meaning: Review burden and model precision risk.

aivision.name: Inspection Coverage
aivision.formula: 100 × assets/images successfully inspected and mapped ÷ eligible assets/images planned
aivision.rules: Blurred, missing, unmapped or unusable images count as uncovered.

workorderintelligence.name: AI Priority Score
workorderintelligence.formula: 100 × [0.25 × Consequence + 0.20 × Failure Likelihood + 0.15 × Urgency + 0.15 × Asset Criticality + 0.15 × Expected Loss + 0.10 × Readiness]
workorderintelligence.scope: Each open recommendation at the latest scoring timestamp.
workorderintelligence.rules: All factors are normalised to 0–1. Safety-critical rules may impose a minimum score. Readiness may reduce schedulability but must not suppress safety urgency.
workorderintelligence.meaning: Higher scores should be reviewed first, subject to permits and operating constraints.

workorderintelligence.name: Recommendation Confidence
workorderintelligence.formula: 100 × [0.35 × Model Probability + 0.25 × Evidence Completeness + 0.20 × Similar-Case Consistency + 0.20 × Data Quality]
workorderintelligence.rules: Confidence is reduced for missing signals, stale data, out-of-domain assets or conflicting evidence. It is not the probability that the action will succeed.
workorderintelligence.meaning: Shows strength of support for the recommendation.

workorderintelligence.name: Expected Generation Loss
workorderintelligence.formula: Expected Power Shortfall (MW) × Expected Duration (h) × Persistence Probability
workorderintelligence.rules: Use counterfactual expected output under comparable irradiance. Subtract unavoidable grid/curtailment loss.
workorderintelligence.meaning: Energy likely to be lost if action is deferred.

workorderintelligence.name: Expected Financial Impact
workorderintelligence.formula: Avoided Generation Loss × Net Tariff + Avoided Repair/Failure Cost − Intervention Cost
workorderintelligence.rules: Use marginal rather than sunk costs; state whether values are gross or net of warranty/insurance recovery.
workorderintelligence.meaning: Net economic value of acting versus deferring.

workorderintelligence.name: Ready-to-Schedule Rate
workorderintelligence.formula: 100 × Recommendations with approvals, permits, parts and crew prerequisites complete ÷ Approved Recommendations
workorderintelligence.rules: A recommendation counts as ready only when every mandatory prerequisite is satisfied.
workorderintelligence.meaning: Measures execution readiness, not technical priority.

workorderintelligence.name: Approval Cycle Time
workorderintelligence.formula: Σ (Final Decision Timestamp − Submission Timestamp) ÷ Number of Decided Cases
workorderintelligence.rules: Pause time may be excluded only when formally placed on hold. Open cases are shown separately as ageing.

corrective.name: MTTR
corrective.formula: Σ (Return-to-Service Time − Confirmed Failure Time) ÷ Number of Restored Failures
corrective.scope: Failures restored in the selected period.
corrective.rules: Exclude planned maintenance and records without valid start/end timestamps; define whether logistics waiting time is included.
corrective.meaning: Lower is better, but must be read with repeat-failure rate.

corrective.name: MTBF
corrective.formula: Σ Operating Time Between Failures ÷ Number of Functional Failures
corrective.rules: Use only comparable failure modes and operating exposure. Do not use calendar hours where the asset was not required to operate.

corrective.name: Open Corrective Work Orders
corrective.formula: Count of corrective work orders with status Open, Approved, Scheduled, In Progress or On Hold
corrective.rules: Exclude cancelled, rejected, duplicate and closed records.

corrective.name: Breakdowns (30d)
corrective.formula: Count of distinct unplanned functional-failure events with start time in trailing 30 days
corrective.rules: Correlated alarms belonging to one incident count once.

corrective.name: Repeat Failure Rate
corrective.formula: 100 × Failures recurring on the same asset/failure-mode within the recurrence window ÷ Restored Failures
corrective.scope: Default recurrence window stated in configuration, e.g. 30/60/90 days.
corrective.rules: Temporary repairs and duplicate notifications are not separate successful closures.
corrective.meaning: High values indicate ineffective diagnosis or repair.

preventive.name: PM Compliance Rate
preventive.formula: 100 × Preventive tasks completed on or before allowed due-date tolerance ÷ Preventive tasks due
preventive.rules: This build uses a 0-day tolerance: completion must be on or before PM Due Date. Overdue open and completed-late tasks are non-compliant; future scheduled tasks are excluded.

preventive.name: Overdue Tasks
preventive.formula: Count of due preventive tasks not completed by Due Date + tolerance
preventive.rules: Tasks formally deferred with approved revised date are measured against the revised due date and separately flagged.

preventive.name: Schedule Attainment
preventive.formula: 100 × Preventive work orders completed ÷ Preventive work orders scheduled for the period
preventive.rules: Carry-over work is attributed according to the defined planning rule.
preventive.meaning: Execution performance against the frozen schedule.

preventive.name: Average Days Overdue
preventive.formula: Σ max(0, As-of Date − Due Date) ÷ Number of overdue tasks
preventive.rules: Use calendar or working days consistently.
preventive.meaning: Age and severity of the overdue backlog.

preventive.name: Preventive Effectiveness
preventive.formula: 100 × PM tasks followed by no targeted failure within validation window ÷ PM tasks with completed validation window
preventive.scope: Completed PM tasks mature enough for outcome assessment.
preventive.rules: Compare only tasks linked to the failure mode they are intended to prevent.
preventive.meaning: Whether scheduled work is actually reducing failures.

adaptive.name: Assets on Adaptive Schedule
adaptive.formula: Count of active assets with at least one approved dynamically adjusted maintenance interval

adaptive.name: Average Interval Compression
adaptive.formula: 100 × Σ (Baseline Interval − Current Interval) ÷ Σ Baseline Interval
adaptive.rules: Negative values represent interval extension; report compression and extension separately when mixed.
adaptive.meaning: Average degree to which tasks have been brought forward.

adaptive.name: Condition Triggers (30d)
adaptive.formula: Count of distinct adaptive maintenance triggers raised in trailing 30 days
adaptive.rules: Repeated readings within one persisted condition episode count once.

adaptive.name: Interventions Avoided
adaptive.formula: Count of baseline scheduled interventions legitimately deferred beyond the reporting period because adaptive evidence remained within limits
adaptive.rules: Do not count cancelled tasks, decommissioned assets or statutory tasks.

adaptive.name: Adaptive Savings
adaptive.formula: Avoided Labour + Avoided Mobilisation + Avoided Downtime − Added Monitoring/Analysis Cost
adaptive.rules: Only approved interval changes with attributable cost baselines are included.

predictive.name: Failure Probability
predictive.formula: 100 × Model probability of the specified failure mode within the stated prediction horizon
predictive.scope: Per asset, failure mode and model run.
predictive.rules: Must always be displayed with horizon and model version; recalibrate when observed event rates drift.
predictive.meaning: Likelihood within a defined horizon, not lifetime certainty.

predictive.name: Remaining Useful Life
predictive.formula: Estimated time/usage until the predicted health indicator crosses the defined functional-failure threshold
predictive.rules: Report confidence interval where available. Cap values outside the trained range and flag extrapolation.
predictive.meaning: Estimated planning time before threshold breach.

predictive.name: Average Detection Lead Time
predictive.formula: Σ (Failure Time − First Qualified Alert Time) ÷ Number of correctly predicted failures
predictive.rules: Alert must meet persistence/confidence threshold; exclude alerts raised after failure onset.
predictive.meaning: How much planning time the model provides.

predictive.name: False Positive Rate
predictive.formula: 100 × False Positive Alerts ÷ (False Positive Alerts + True Negative Opportunities)
predictive.rules: Where true negatives are impractical, label and use False Discovery Rate = FP ÷ all alerts instead.
predictive.meaning: How often normal cases are incorrectly flagged.

predictive.name: Condition Score
predictive.rules: Normalisation is asset/model specific; 100 represents reference healthy condition and 0 the failure threshold or worse.
predictive.meaning: Comparable health indicator only within governed asset/model scope.

predictive.name: Model Coverage
predictive.formula: 100 × Assets receiving a valid current prediction ÷ Eligible assets
predictive.rules: Exclude assets outside model scope; invalid/stale predictions count as uncovered.
predictive.meaning: How much of the eligible fleet is actively monitored.

prescriptive.name: Recommendation Acceptance Rate
prescriptive.rules: Exclude pending and withdrawn recommendations. Overrides should be analysed separately.

prescriptive.name: Average Recommendation Confidence
prescriptive.formula: Σ Recommendation Confidence ÷ Number of active recommendations
prescriptive.rules: Prefer weighted average by business exposure when explicitly labelled; otherwise simple average.

prescriptive.name: Estimated Cost Avoided
prescriptive.formula: Σ [Expected Failure Cost without action − Expected Cost with recommended action]
prescriptive.rules: Probability-weight both scenarios and avoid counting realised savings until verified.

prescriptive.name: Repair-Now Recommendations
prescriptive.formula: Count of active recommendations whose optimal action window begins now or within configured urgent threshold
prescriptive.rules: Cancelled, superseded or rejected items are excluded.

prescriptive.name: Verified Benefit Realisation
prescriptive.formula: 100 × Verified realised benefit ÷ Approved expected benefit for completed interventions
prescriptive.meaning: Whether predicted value was actually delivered.

riskbased.name: Composite Risk Score
riskbased.formula: Normalised Likelihood × Normalised Consequence; optionally adjusted by Detectability and Exposure
riskbased.scope: Per risk item at latest assessment.
riskbased.rules: State configured weights and scale. Safety/regulatory consequence may set minimum tier regardless of product score.

riskbased.name: Critical-Tier Items
riskbased.formula: Count of active items with Composite Risk Score at or above critical threshold, or mandatory critical rule triggered

riskbased.name: Residual Risk
riskbased.rules: Control effectiveness must be evidence-based and bounded 0–1.

riskbased.name: Risk Reduction
riskbased.scope: Per treatment plan or aggregated portfolio.
riskbased.rules: Undefined when inherent risk is zero; exclude such records.

riskbased.name: Risk Exposure Value
riskbased.rules: Keep safety and compliance impacts separately visible even when not monetised.

rcm.name: Asset Classes Reviewed
rcm.formula: Count of distinct asset classes with an approved RCM analysis version
rcm.rules: Draft or expired reviews are excluded.

rcm.name: Strategy Coverage
rcm.formula: 100 × Critical maintainable assets with approved failure-mode strategy ÷ Critical maintainable assets
rcm.rules: Every material failure mode must map to a valid strategy: condition-based, scheduled restoration/discard, failure-finding, redesign or run-to-failure.

rcm.name: RCM Action Closure Rate
rcm.formula: 100 × RCM improvement actions closed ÷ RCM actions due
rcm.rules: Closed requires evidence and approval, not only task completion.

rcm.name: Strategy Effectiveness
rcm.formula: 100 × Targeted failure modes showing improved failure rate after strategy change ÷ Mature strategy changes evaluated
rcm.scope: Only changes with sufficient post-implementation exposure.
rcm.rules: Control for operating exposure and asset comparability.

opportunistic.name: Tasks Bundled
opportunistic.formula: Count of additional ready tasks added to an already planned visit/outage
opportunistic.rules: Primary task is not counted as bundled; each additional work order counts once.

opportunistic.name: Truck-Rolls Saved
opportunistic.formula: Baseline standalone mobilisations − Actual mobilisations after bundling
opportunistic.rules: Only count mobilisations demonstrably avoided; do not count remote tasks.

opportunistic.name: Opportunity Value
opportunistic.formula: Avoided Future Mobilisation + Avoided Future Outage Loss − Incremental Labour/Material/Risk Cost
opportunistic.rules: Use marginal costs and probability-weighted avoided loss.
opportunistic.meaning: Net value of adding work to the opportunity.

opportunistic.name: Bundle Readiness Rate
opportunistic.formula: 100 × Candidate tasks with parts, skills, permits and time-window readiness ÷ Candidate tasks
opportunistic.rules: All mandatory prerequisites must be complete.
opportunistic.meaning: How much candidate scope can safely be executed.

opportunistic.name: Critical-Path Extension
opportunistic.formula: Bundled outage finish time − Primary-scope finish time
opportunistic.rules: Zero when added tasks do not extend the critical path.

approval.name: Awaiting Approval
approval.formula: Count of submitted cases without final approve/reject decision
approval.rules: Cases returned for information remain pending but should be separately identified.

approval.name: Average Cycle Time
approval.formula: Σ (Final Decision Time − Submission Time − Approved Hold Time) ÷ Number of decided cases
approval.rules: Use the same hold-time rule across screens.

approval.name: Approval SLA Compliance
approval.formula: 100 × cases decided within applicable SLA ÷ cases decided
approval.rules: SLA may vary by risk tier; evaluate each case against its own SLA.

approval.name: Override Rate
approval.formula: 100 × approved decisions that override system recommendation ÷ decided recommendations

approval.name: Evidence Completeness
approval.formula: 100 × mandatory evidence fields/documents present and valid ÷ mandatory evidence items
approval.rules: Expired, unreadable or unlinked evidence counts as missing.

maintenancelearning.name: Repair Success Rate
maintenancelearning.formula: 100 × Successful comparable interventions ÷ Comparable completed interventions
maintenancelearning.scope: By failure mode, asset class and selected period; shown to two decimals.
maintenancelearning.rules: Successful means restored function with no recurrence within the defined validation window and no unresolved safety/quality exception. Exclude incomplete and temporary closures.
maintenancelearning.meaning: Observed effectiveness of a repair practice.

maintenancelearning.name: First-Time Fix Rate
maintenancelearning.formula: 100 × work orders resolved without repeat visit/reopen within validation window ÷ completed eligible work orders
maintenancelearning.rules: Planned follow-up inspections do not count as repeat repair.

maintenancelearning.name: Recurrence Rate
maintenancelearning.formula: 100 × successful closures followed by same failure mode on same/comparable asset within recurrence window ÷ eligible closures
maintenancelearning.rules: Use consistent failure taxonomy and exposure.

maintenancelearning.name: Recommendation Confidence
maintenancelearning.formula: 100 × [0.30 × Sample Adequacy + 0.25 × Outcome Consistency + 0.20 × Recency + 0.15 × Data Completeness + 0.10 × Context Similarity]
maintenancelearning.rules: A high observed success rate with a small sample receives lower confidence.
maintenancelearning.meaning: Trust level for promoting a learned practice.

maintenancelearning.name: Actual vs Planned Duration Variance
maintenancelearning.formula: 100 × (Actual Labour/Elapsed Duration − Planned Duration) ÷ Planned Duration
maintenancelearning.scope: Completed work orders with valid plan and actuals.
maintenancelearning.rules: Separate elapsed time from wrench time where available.

maintenancelearning.name: Cost Variance
maintenancelearning.rules: Actual cost includes configured labour, parts, contractor and mobilisation components.

assetrelationships.name: Relationship Strength
assetrelationships.formula: Weighted association measure derived from co-occurrence, temporal proximity, recurrence and configured domain rules
assetrelationships.rules: The exact weights depend on relationship type; strength is not causal proof.

assetrelationships.name: Relationship Confidence
assetrelationships.formula: 100 × [0.35 × Evidence Quality + 0.25 × Evidence Quantity + 0.20 × Cross-Source Agreement + 0.20 × Human/Rule Validation]
assetrelationships.rules: Conflicting, stale or low-quality evidence reduces confidence.
assetrelationships.meaning: Support for believing the relationship is valid.

assetrelationships.name: Similar-Case Score
assetrelationships.formula: 100 × Σ (Feature Weight × Feature Similarity) ÷ Σ Feature Weights
assetrelationships.scope: Current incident versus each historical case.
assetrelationships.rules: Typical features include asset type/model, failure mode, alarm sequence, environment, age and operating state.
assetrelationships.meaning: How operationally comparable a prior case is.

assetrelationships.name: Graph Coverage
assetrelationships.formula: 100 × entities with at least one governed relationship ÷ eligible entities
assetrelationships.rules: Isolated or unmapped entities count as uncovered.

assetrelationships.name: Approved Relationship Rate
assetrelationships.rules: Proposed and rejected edges are excluded from numerator; rejected are normally inactive.

assetrelationships.name: Scenario Failure Probability
assetrelationships.formula: Base Failure Probability adjusted by configured scenario multipliers for heat, health, lead time, technician availability and relationship strength
assetrelationships.rules: Multipliers must be bounded and displayed; simulation output is not a live forecast unless explicitly stated.

models.name: Models Catalogued
models.formula: Count of unique governed model/version records in the registry
models.rules: Retired versions remain catalogued but are separated by status.

models.name: Production Rate
models.formula: 100 × models with Production status ÷ catalogued active models
models.rules: Exclude retired/archived models from denominator when labelled active-model rate.

models.name: Drift Rate
models.formula: 100 × monitored production models breaching drift threshold ÷ monitored production models
models.rules: A model without current monitoring data is reported as unmonitored, not non-drifting.

models.name: Validation Pass Rate
models.formula: 100 × model versions passing all mandatory validation gates ÷ model versions evaluated
models.rules: Partial or conditional passes should be separately labelled.

models.name: Model Freshness
models.formula: As-of Timestamp − Last successful training/calibration/validation timestamp
models.rules: Use the event relevant to the model’s governance policy.
models.meaning: Age of the current approved model evidence.

spares.name: Below Reorder Point
spares.formula: Count of active stock items where Available Stock ≤ Reorder Point
spares.rules: Available Stock = On-hand − Reserved − Quality Hold; optionally + confirmed inbound within lead-time horizon only if configured.
spares.meaning: Number of items requiring replenishment review.

spares.name: Reorder Point
spares.formula: Average Demand During Lead Time + Safety Stock
spares.rules: Average demand and lead time must use compatible periods; safety stock follows selected service-level method.

spares.name: Inventory Value
spares.formula: Σ On-hand Quantity × governed unit valuation cost
spares.rules: State valuation basis: standard, moving average or latest purchase cost.

spares.name: Average Supplier Lead Time
spares.formula: Σ (Receipt Date − Approved PO Date) ÷ Number of completed PO lines
spares.rules: Use quantity-weighted average only when labelled; exclude cancelled lines.

spares.name: RUL-Linked Reorders
spares.formula: Count of replenishment recommendations triggered because predicted demand within lead time exceeds available stock
spares.rules: Recommendation must link to a valid predictive risk and bill-of-material/part mapping.

spares.name: Stockout Risk
spares.formula: 100 × probability that demand during replenishment lead time exceeds usable stock
spares.rules: Calculated from demand and lead-time distributions or governed scenario logic.
spares.meaning: Likelihood of inability to support expected work.

inventory.name: Closing Balance
inventory.formula: Opening Balance + Receipts + Positive Adjustments − Issues − Negative Adjustments
inventory.rules: Transfers must be recorded as issue at source and receipt at destination without double counting fleet total.

inventory.name: Days of Inventory
inventory.formula: Usable On-hand Quantity ÷ Average Daily Demand
inventory.scope: Per item/location; fleet average must state weighting.
inventory.rules: If average demand is zero, show N/A rather than infinity. Use trailing demand window stated in configuration.
inventory.meaning: Estimated coverage at recent demand rate.

inventory.name: Inventory Turnover
inventory.formula: Annualised Issue Value ÷ Average Inventory Value
inventory.rules: Average inventory = (opening + closing)/2 or time-weighted average, as configured.

inventory.name: Service Level
inventory.formula: 100 × demand lines fulfilled in full by required date ÷ eligible demand lines
inventory.rules: Backorders and partial fills are non-compliant unless the service definition states otherwise.

inventory.name: Inventory Accuracy
inventory.formula: 100 × items/locations where physical count equals book quantity within tolerance ÷ items counted
inventory.rules: State tolerance; unexplained adjustments are not accuracy.

warrantyrecovery.name: Eligible Claim Value
warrantyrecovery.formula: Σ [Eligible Repair/Replacement Cost + Eligible Logistics/Labour + Contractual Consequential Amount]
warrantyrecovery.scope: Open opportunities under applicable warranty terms.
warrantyrecovery.rules: Apply coverage limits, deductibles, depreciation and exclusions. Avoid overlap with insurance/PPA recovery.
warrantyrecovery.meaning: Gross value that may be claimed.

warrantyrecovery.name: Expected Recovery
warrantyrecovery.formula: Eligible Claim Value × Claim Success Probability × Recoverable Share
warrantyrecovery.rules: Probability reflects evidence, precedent, warranty status and OEM response; recoverable share accounts for caps/exclusions.

warrantyrecovery.name: Days Open
warrantyrecovery.scope: Per claim; synthetic and Excel modes.
warrantyrecovery.rules: Use whole calendar days and display as an integer. Closed claims use Close Date − Open Date when analysing cycle time.

warrantyrecovery.name: Evidence Completeness
warrantyrecovery.formula: 100 × valid mandatory evidence items present ÷ mandatory evidence items required for that claim type
warrantyrecovery.rules: Expired, mismatched or untraceable documents count as missing.

warrantyrecovery.name: Claim Conversion Rate
warrantyrecovery.formula: 100 × claims accepted/settled ÷ claims with final OEM decision
warrantyrecovery.rules: Withdrawn/duplicate claims are excluded. Partial settlements count according to configured rule.

warrantyrecovery.name: OEM Exposure
warrantyrecovery.formula: Σ Eligible Claim Value for open claims grouped by OEM
warrantyrecovery.rules: Do not treat exposure as confirmed OEM liability.

crewscheduling.name: Technician Utilisation
crewscheduling.formula: 100 × productive assigned hours ÷ available roster hours
crewscheduling.rules: Available hours exclude approved leave, training and non-working shifts; distinguish travel if needed.

crewscheduling.name: Schedule Fill Rate
crewscheduling.formula: 100 × required work hours assigned to qualified available crew ÷ required work hours
crewscheduling.rules: Assignments without mandatory certification/skill do not count as filled.

crewscheduling.name: Skill Match Rate
crewscheduling.formula: 100 × assignments meeting every mandatory skill/certification requirement ÷ assignments

crewscheduling.name: Average Hourly Cost
crewscheduling.formula: Σ labour cost for rostered/assigned hours ÷ Σ corresponding hours
crewscheduling.rules: State whether cost is standard, actual or fully loaded.

crewscheduling.name: Travel Efficiency
crewscheduling.formula: 100 × productive field hours ÷ (productive field hours + travel hours)
crewscheduling.meaning: Proportion of field time spent on productive work.

crewscheduling.name: First-Time Fix by Crew
crewscheduling.formula: 100 × eligible work completed without repeat visit/reopen ÷ eligible completed work
crewscheduling.rules: Adjust comparisons for task complexity and failure type.

esgoverview.name: Renewable Generation
esgoverview.scope: Selected reporting period and organisational boundary.
esgoverview.rules: Use governed meter hierarchy and remove duplicate meters.

esgoverview.name: Avoided Emissions
esgoverview.formula: Renewable Generation × approved displaced-grid emission factor
esgoverview.rules: Report methodology and factor vintage; this is avoided-emissions reporting, not automatically a carbon credit.

esgoverview.name: Net Carbon Benefit
esgoverview.formula: Avoided Emissions − Scope 1 − Location/market-based Scope 2 used for operations − included lifecycle/Scope 3 emissions
esgoverview.rules: State which emissions categories are included.
esgoverview.meaning: Net climate benefit after operational emissions.

esgoverview.name: Water Consumption Intensity
esgoverview.rules: Consumption = withdrawal − discharge/returned water under the chosen standard.

esgoverview.name: Waste Diversion Rate
esgoverview.formula: 100 × waste reused + recycled + recovered ÷ total waste generated
esgoverview.rules: Exclude waste sent to landfill/incineration without recovery; retain hazardous-waste category.

esgoverview.name: LTIFR
esgoverview.scope: Selected period, employees and contractors per boundary.
esgoverview.rules: Use the organisation’s governed multiplier if different.

esgoverview.name: ESG Exceptions
esgoverview.formula: Count of open ESG data, target, compliance or threshold exceptions
esgoverview.rules: One underlying issue should not be duplicated across categories.

carbonwater.name: Generation Attainment
carbonwater.rules: Use like-for-like plant boundary and approved target version.

carbonwater.name: Downtime Loss
carbonwater.formula: Σ Counterfactual Available Power during equipment downtime × interval duration
carbonwater.rules: Exclude grid/curtailment and weather shortfall; prevent overlap across nested assets.

carbonwater.name: Curtailment Loss
carbonwater.formula: Σ (Available Export Potential − Allowed/Actual Export due to curtailment) × interval duration
carbonwater.rules: Require grid/operator curtailment evidence and cap at technically available generation.

carbonwater.name: Avoided Emissions
carbonwater.formula: Eligible Renewable Generation × approved grid factor
carbonwater.rules: Same governed methodology as ESG Overview.

carbonwater.name: Recycled Water Share
carbonwater.formula: 100 × recycled/reused water consumed ÷ total water consumed
carbonwater.rules: Do not count the same water repeatedly through internal recirculation unless methodology permits.

carbonwater.name: Water Intensity
carbonwater.rules: Validate generation and water boundaries match.

circularity.name: Circularity Rate
circularity.formula: 100 × mass of materials/waste reused, refurbished, remanufactured or recycled ÷ total material/waste outflow in scope
circularity.rules: Define whether energy recovery is included; avoid counting transfers twice.

circularity.name: Recovery Rate
circularity.formula: 100 × recovered waste mass ÷ total waste generated

circularity.name: E-waste Compliance Rate
circularity.formula: 100 × e-waste mass transferred to authorised recyclers with valid documentation ÷ total e-waste generated
circularity.rules: Missing certificate/manifests count as non-compliant until resolved.

circularity.name: Certificate Exceptions
circularity.formula: Count of waste movements lacking valid mandatory certificate, manifest or authorised vendor proof
circularity.rules: A movement can have multiple missing documents but counts once in headline KPI.

hseclimate.name: TRIR
hseclimate.formula: Total Recordable Incidents × 200,000 ÷ Total Hours Worked
hseclimate.scope: Selected period and governed workforce boundary.

hseclimate.name: Near-Miss Reporting Rate
hseclimate.formula: Near Misses Reported × 200,000 ÷ Total Hours Worked
hseclimate.rules: A higher rate can indicate stronger reporting rather than worse safety; interpret with severity and action closure.

hseclimate.name: HSE Action Closure Rate
hseclimate.formula: 100 × HSE actions closed by due date ÷ HSE actions due

hseclimate.name: Climate Value at Risk
hseclimate.formula: Σ Asset/Revenue Exposure × Hazard Probability × Vulnerability Factor over stated horizon
hseclimate.rules: Avoid adding mutually exclusive scenarios; state whether result is expected loss, percentile VaR or stress loss.
hseclimate.meaning: Financial exposure to physical climate hazards.

hseclimate.name: Compliance Action Ageing
hseclimate.formula: As-of Date − action creation/due date, summarised by average/maximum or ageing bucket
hseclimate.rules: The screen must label which ageing basis is used.

integrations.name: Latency
integrations.formula: Message/record available-in-AIP timestamp − source-system event/commit timestamp
integrations.scope: Latest interval or selected rolling window.
integrations.rules: Use median and p95 for streams; clock synchronisation is required.

integrations.name: Throughput
integrations.rules: Exclude retries from successful unique count unless labelled attempts.

integrations.name: Success Rate
integrations.rules: Retries should be linked to the original transaction to avoid inflated denominator.

integrations.name: Data Freshness
integrations.formula: As-of Timestamp − timestamp of latest valid source record
integrations.rules: A successful sync with no new business data does not necessarily improve source-data freshness.

integrations.name: Reconciliation Variance
integrations.formula: Source record/value total − AIP accepted record/value total
integrations.rules: Account for intentionally rejected/filtered records separately.

integrations.name: Availability
integrations.formula: 100 × monitored time interface was operational ÷ total scheduled monitored time
integrations.rules: Exclude approved maintenance only when SLA definition allows.

climateintelligence.name: Hazard Score
climateintelligence.formula: 100 × normalised probability/severity of the selected climate hazard under the chosen scenario and horizon
climateintelligence.rules: Method may combine return period, intensity and trend; disclose source/model.

climateintelligence.name: Exposure Score
climateintelligence.formula: 100 × value/capacity of assets located within the hazard footprint ÷ total site/portfolio value/capacity
climateintelligence.rules: Use replacement value, MW or other selected exposure base consistently.

climateintelligence.name: Vulnerability Score
climateintelligence.formula: 100 × expected damage/performance sensitivity given hazard intensity, design and controls
climateintelligence.rules: Reflect adaptation controls and asset-specific fragility.

climateintelligence.name: Climate Risk Score
climateintelligence.formula: Hazard × Exposure × Vulnerability, normalised to configured scale
climateintelligence.rules: Do not average incompatible scenarios without explicit weighting.

climateintelligence.name: Expected Annual Loss
climateintelligence.formula: Σ Probability of hazard intensity band × Damage/Revenue Loss for that band
climateintelligence.rules: Use full probability distribution where available.

climateintelligence.name: Adaptation Benefit-Cost Ratio
climateintelligence.formula: Present Value of avoided climate losses ÷ Present Value of adaptation cost
climateintelligence.rules: State discount rate, horizon and residual value.

dataexplorer.name: Rows Analysed
dataexplorer.formula: Count of records included after active filters and validation exclusions

dataexplorer.name: Data Completeness
dataexplorer.formula: 100 × populated mandatory cells ÷ mandatory cells expected
dataexplorer.rules: Blank, null and invalid placeholders count as missing.

dataexplorer.name: Query Match Rate
dataexplorer.formula: 100 × records satisfying query conditions ÷ records searched
dataexplorer.rules: Semantic/NLP queries should show resolved filters where possible.

dataexplorer.name: Aggregation Result
dataexplorer.formula: Defined aggregate such as SUM, COUNT, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX or weighted average over filtered records
dataexplorer.rules: The chosen aggregation and denominator must be shown; averages should state simple versus weighted.
dataexplorer.meaning: Computed answer returned by the explorer.

datamanagement.name: Detected Worksheets
datamanagement.formula: Count of workbook sheets recognised by exact or mapped supported sheet names
datamanagement.rules: Hidden sheets count only if read and supported.

datamanagement.name: Valid Row Rate
datamanagement.formula: 100 × rows passing mandatory field, type, range and referential checks ÷ rows evaluated
datamanagement.rules: Header rows and intentionally blank template rows are excluded.

datamanagement.name: Rejected Rows
datamanagement.formula: Count of rows failing one or more blocking validation rules
datamanagement.rules: A row with multiple errors counts once in headline KPI; errors remain itemised.

datamanagement.name: Referential Integrity Rate
datamanagement.formula: 100 × foreign-key references resolving to a valid master record ÷ foreign-key references evaluated
datamanagement.rules: Null optional references are excluded; mandatory nulls fail completeness.

datamanagement.name: Screen Coverage
datamanagement.formula: 100 × required supported datasets present and valid ÷ datasets required for selected screen set
datamanagement.rules: A present sheet with no valid rows does not count as covered.
datamanagement.meaning: How much of AIP can be driven by uploaded data.

datamanagement.name: Duplicate Rate
datamanagement.rules: Use governed composite business key; exact duplicate handling must be stated.

executiveperformance.name: Generation vs Budget
executiveperformance.rules: Use current approved budget version and like-for-like operational sites.

executiveperformance.name: EBITDA/Revenue Impact from Operations
executiveperformance.formula: Σ operational energy variance × net realised tariff − incremental operational cost
executiveperformance.rules: State whether figure is gross revenue, contribution margin or EBITDA impact.

executiveperformance.name: Reliability Index
executiveperformance.formula: 100 × [weighted Availability, MTBF, repeat-failure and critical-backlog components]
executiveperformance.rules: Weights and normalisation must be governed; disclose any missing component.

executiveperformance.name: Value at Risk
executiveperformance.formula: Σ probability-weighted downside from open operational, commercial, warranty, ESG and climate exposures
executiveperformance.rules: Avoid overlaps among the same underlying event; retain category breakdown.

executiveperformance.name: Action Value Realised
executiveperformance.formula: Σ verified realised benefit of closed management actions
executiveperformance.rules: Do not recognise forecast value until outcome evidence is approved.

rootcause.name: RCA Confidence
rootcause.formula: 100 × [0.30 × Evidence Completeness + 0.25 × Temporal Consistency + 0.20 × Causal-Rule Fit + 0.15 × Similar-Case Support + 0.10 × Engineer Validation]
rootcause.rules: Confidence is support, not proof; conflicting evidence reduces score.
rootcause.meaning: Strength of the selected cause hypothesis.

rootcause.name: Time to Root Cause
rootcause.formula: Root Cause Confirmed Timestamp − Incident Start Timestamp
rootcause.rules: If confirmation is pending, show ageing separately.

rootcause.name: Repeat Incident Rate
rootcause.formula: 100 × incidents matching an earlier confirmed causal pattern within lookback window ÷ incidents analysed
rootcause.rules: Similarity threshold and causal pattern definition must be stated.

rootcause.name: Root Cause Distribution
rootcause.formula: Count of confirmed incidents grouped by governed root-cause category
rootcause.rules: Each incident has one primary cause; contributing factors are reported separately to prevent double counting.

rootcause.name: Evidence Coverage
rootcause.formula: 100 × required evidence sources available/valid ÷ required evidence sources for the incident type
rootcause.rules: Sources may include SCADA, alarm, weather, inspection and work history.

rootcause.name: Corrective Action Effectiveness
rootcause.formula: 100 × confirmed-root-cause incidents with no recurrence after completed action within validation window ÷ mature completed actions
rootcause.rules: Exclude temporary containment from permanent-action effectiveness.
rootcause.meaning: Whether RCA led to durable prevention.

lossintelligence.name: Total Energy Loss
lossintelligence.formula: Σ max(0, Expected Generation − Actual Generation) after governed attribution and overlap resolution
lossintelligence.rules: Expected baseline must be stated; weather variance is not automatically technical loss.

lossintelligence.name: Loss Rate
lossintelligence.rules: Expected generation must be positive and valid.

lossintelligence.name: Recoverable Loss
lossintelligence.formula: Σ loss attributed to controllable causes × technically/economically recoverable fraction
lossintelligence.rules: Exclude grid, unavoidable weather and already permanently constrained output unless action can change it.

lossintelligence.name: Revenue Loss
lossintelligence.formula: Σ Attributed Lost Energy × applicable net tariff/settlement rate
lossintelligence.rules: Account for deemed generation and contractual exclusions.

lossintelligence.name: Top Loss Contributor Share
lossintelligence.formula: 100 × largest loss-category MWh ÷ total attributed loss MWh
lossintelligence.rules: Categories must be mutually exclusive after overlap resolution.

lossintelligence.name: Recovery Realisation
lossintelligence.formula: 100 × verified energy recovered after action ÷ forecast recoverable energy
lossintelligence.meaning: Accuracy and delivery of recovery actions.

siteperformance.name: Performance Ratio
siteperformance.formula: 100 × Actual AC Energy ÷ [POA Irradiance × Installed DC Capacity × reference normalisation]
siteperformance.rules: Use valid daylight intervals and governed IEC/company method.

siteperformance.name: Technical Availability
siteperformance.rules: State exclusions for grid, planned outage and curtailment.
siteperformance.meaning: Capability of plant equipment to generate.

siteperformance.name: Specific Yield
siteperformance.formula: Actual AC Energy (kWh) ÷ Installed DC Capacity (kWp)
siteperformance.rules: Capacity basis must remain constant/dated for expansions.

siteperformance.name: Capacity Factor
siteperformance.formula: 100 × Actual Energy ÷ (Installed AC Capacity × Calendar Hours)
siteperformance.rules: Use AC or DC denominator consistently and label it.

siteperformance.name: Site Loss Rate
siteperformance.formula: 100 × Attributed Site Loss ÷ Expected Site Generation
siteperformance.rules: Avoid overlap between downtime, performance, grid and curtailment categories.

commercialppa.name: PPA Delivery Attainment
commercialppa.rules: Apply contract rules for deemed generation, banking and exclusions.

commercialppa.name: Revenue Realisation
commercialppa.formula: Actual recognised/settled revenue ÷ Theoretical revenue at contracted tariff × 100
commercialppa.rules: Theoretical revenue basis must reflect eligible energy and tariff schedule.
commercialppa.meaning: Commercial conversion of generation into revenue.

commercialppa.name: Shortfall Energy
commercialppa.formula: max(0, Contracted/Committed Energy − Eligible Delivered/Deemed Energy)

commercialppa.name: Penalty Exposure
commercialppa.formula: Σ shortfall/availability breach quantity × applicable contractual penalty rate
commercialppa.rules: Use clause-specific caps, bands and cure periods.

commercialppa.name: Curtailment Compensation
commercialppa.formula: Eligible curtailed energy × contractual compensation rate
commercialppa.rules: Only curtailment meeting evidence and clause conditions is included.

commercialppa.name: PPA Availability
commercialppa.formula: 100 × Contractually Available Capacity-Hours ÷ Contractual Required Capacity-Hours
commercialppa.rules: Use PPA-specific exclusions, which may differ from technical availability.

managementactions.name: Open Actions
managementactions.formula: Count of actions not Closed, Cancelled or Rejected
managementactions.rules: On-hold actions remain open and are separately identified.

managementactions.name: Overdue Actions
managementactions.formula: Count of open actions where As-of Date > Due Date
managementactions.rules: Approved revised due dates replace original for compliance, while original remains in audit history.

managementactions.name: On-Time Closure Rate
managementactions.formula: 100 × actions closed on/before due date ÷ actions closed

managementactions.name: Value at Stake
managementactions.formula: Σ probability-weighted financial/energy/risk value linked to open actions
managementactions.rules: Do not sum mixed units into one number unless monetised through an approved method.

managementactions.name: Value Realisation Rate
managementactions.formula: 100 × verified realised value ÷ approved expected value of mature closed actions
managementactions.scope: Closed actions with completed verification period.
managementactions.rules: Forecast or self-reported benefits without evidence remain unverified.

managementactions.name: Average Action Age
managementactions.formula: Σ (As-of Date − Created Date) ÷ open actions
managementactions.rules: Use calendar days and show ageing distribution for skewed backlog.
